title: The next version of Android will reportedly be designed to support notches - just like the iPhone X (GOOG, AAPL)
text: The next version of Android will reportedly be designed to support notches — just like the iPhone X (GOOG, AAPL) By Edoardo Maggio Feb 12, 2018, 7:22 am 39 pts Google is working on a new version of Android, Android P, whose internal codename appears to be "Pistachio Ice Cream." Android P will apparently feature a drastic visual overhaul, the first one the OS has seen since Android Lollipop and the introduction of Material Design in 2014. The system is…
